text_en: Moses assembled all the congregation of the Israelites and said to them: These are the things that the Lord has commanded you to do:
text_cn: 梅瑟召集以色列子民全会众，向他们说：“这是上主吩咐你们应遵行的事：

text_en: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day you shall have a holy sabbath of solemn rest to the Lord ; whoever does any work on it shall be put to death.
text_cn: 六日内作工，第七日为你们是圣日，应完全为上主安息；凡在这一日作工的，应受死刑。

text_en: You shall kindle no fire in all your dwellings on the sabbath day.
text_cn: 安息日不准在你们住的一切地方生火。”

text_en: Moses said to all the congregation of the Israelites: This is the thing that the Lord has commanded:
text_cn: 梅瑟又训示以色列子民全会众说：“上主这样命令说：

text_en: Take from among you an offering to the Lord ; let whoever is of a generous heart bring the Lord ’s offering: gold, silver, and bronze;
text_cn: 由你们财物中取一份作献仪，献给上主；凡甘心乐捐的，可献于上主的献仪是：金、银、铜，

text_en: blue, purple, and crimson yarns, and fine linen; goats’ hair,
text_cn: 紫色、红色、朱红色的毛线、细麻和山羊毛，

text_en: tanned rams’ skins, and fine leather; acacia wood,
text_cn: 染红的公羊皮、海豚皮及皂荚木，

text_en: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense,
text_cn: 灯油，为制傅礼的油和焚香用的香料，

text_en: and onyx stones and gems to be set in the ephod and the breastpiece.
text_cn: 红玛瑙石和为镶在厄弗得和胸牌上的宝石。

text_en: All who are skillful among you shall come and make all that the Lord has commanded: the tabernacle,
text_cn: 你们中间凡有天才的人，都要来制造上主所命令的一切：

text_en: its tent and its covering, its clasps and its frames, its bars, its pillars, and its bases;
text_cn: 帐棚、棚顶和棚罩，钩子、木板、横木、柱子和卯(mǎo)座，

text_en: the ark with its poles, the mercy seat, and the curtain for the screen;
text_cn: 约柜和杠杆，赎罪盖、遮赎罪盖的帐幔，

text_en: the table with its poles and all its utensils, and the bread of the Presence;
text_cn: 供桌和杠杆，并一切器具，以及供饼，

text_en: the lampstand also for the light, with its utensils and its lamps, and the oil for the light;
text_cn: 灯台及其用具，灯盏和灯油，

text_en: and the altar of incense, with its poles, and the anointing oil and the fragrant incense, and the screen for the entrance, the entrance of the tabernacle;
text_cn: 香坛和杠杆，傅礼的油、香料、帐棚入口的门帘，

text_en: the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its utensils, the basin with its stand;
text_cn: 全燔祭坛和祭坛的铜格子、杠杆及一切器具，盆和盆座，

text_en: the hangings of the court, its pillars and its bases, and the screen for the gate of the court;
text_cn: 庭院的帷幔、柱子、卯（mǎo）座并院门的帘子，

text_en: the pegs of the tabernacle and the pegs of the court, and their cords;
text_cn: 帐棚的橛子、庭院的橛子和绳索，

text_en: the finely worked vestments for ministering in the holy place, the holy vestments for the priest Aaron, and the vestments of his sons, for their service as priests.
text_cn: 圣所内行礼的祭服，亚郎大司祭的圣衣，以及他儿子们行祭的服装。”

text_en: Then all the congregation of the Israelites withdrew from the presence of Moses.
text_cn: 于是以色列子民全会众离开梅瑟而去。

text_en: And they came, everyone whose heart was stirred, and everyone whose spirit was willing, and brought the Lord ’s offering to be used for the tent of meeting, and for all its service, and for the sacred vestments.
text_cn: 凡甘心情愿捐献的人都来送给上主献仪，为制造会幕和会幕中的一切用具及圣衣之用；

text_en: So they came, both men and women; all who were of a willing heart brought brooches and earrings and signet rings and pendants, all sorts of gold objects, everyone bringing an offering of gold to the Lord .
text_cn: 无论男女，凡甘心乐捐的，都把金针、耳环、戒指、项链和各样金器送来，各人都把金子奉献给上主作献仪。

text_en: And everyone who possessed blue or purple or crimson yarn or fine linen or goats’ hair or tanned rams’ skins or fine leather, brought them.
text_cn: 凡有紫色、红色、朱红色毛线、细麻、山羊毛、染红的公羊皮、海豚皮的，也都送来。

text_en: Everyone who could make an offering of silver or bronze brought it as the Lord ’s offering; and everyone who possessed acacia wood of any use in the work, brought it.
text_cn: 凡愿奉献银子和铜的，也送来，奉献给上主作献仪；凡有皂荚木的，也送来，为制造各种应用之物。

text_en: All the skillful women spun with their hands, and brought what they had spun in blue and purple and crimson yarns and fine linen;
text_cn: 凡技巧的妇女都亲手纺线，把所纺的紫色、红色、朱红色毛线和细麻送来。

text_en: all the women whose hearts moved them to use their skill spun the goats’ hair.
text_cn: 凡具有艺术才能的妇女都纺了毛线。

text_en: And the leaders brought onyx stones and gems to be set in the ephod and the breastpiece,
text_cn: 首长奉献了红玛瑙石，镶在厄弗得和胸牌上的宝石，

text_en: and spices and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense.
text_cn: 香料和油，为点灯，为制傅礼的油，为制焚香而用。

text_en: All the Israelite men and women whose hearts made them willing to bring anything for the work that the Lord had commanded by Moses to be done, brought it as a freewill offering to the Lord .
text_cn: 以色列子民，无论男女，凡甘心乐捐，为制造上主藉梅瑟所吩咐的一切工程的，都自愿向上主奉献了礼品。

text_en: Then Moses said to the Israelites: See, the Lord has called by name Bezalel son of Uri son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
text_cn: 梅瑟向以色列子民说：“你们看，上主已提名，召叫了犹大支派的乌黎的儿子，胡尔的孙子贝匝肋耳，

text_en: he has filled him with divine spirit, with skill, intelligence, and knowledge in every kind of craft,
text_cn: 使他充满天主的神，使他有智慧、技能和知识，能作各种工程，

text_en: to devise artistic designs, to work in gold, silver, and bronze,
text_cn: 能设计图案，能用金、银、铜制造器物，

text_en: in cutting stones for setting, and in carving wood, in every kind of craft.
text_cn: 能雕刻宝石，加以镶嵌，雕刻木头，制造各种艺术工程。

text_en: And he has inspired him to teach, both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
text_cn: 上主又赐给他和丹支派的阿希撒玛客的儿子敖曷里雅布领导的才能，

text_en: He has filled them with skill to do every kind of work done by an artisan or by a designer or by an embroiderer in blue, purple, and crimson yarns, and in fine linen, or by a weaver—by any sort of artisan or skilled designer.
text_cn: 使他们充满艺术的才能，能雕刻刺绣，并用紫色、红色、朱红色的毛线和细麻作绣花及编织的各种工作，能做各种工程，能设计图案。”
